summary: Commercial Metals Company filed a Form 8-K on October 13, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing the board's declaration of a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share of common stock. The dividend, CMC's 248th consecutive quarterly payout, is payable November 11, 2026, to holders of record at the close of business October 28, 2026. No advisor, premium, stake, or deal terms were disclosed. This is a routine capital-return declaration rather than a special situation; the arbitrage angle is a standard ex-dividend date trade, with no structural or regulatory risk.
